description: This file defines API route handlers for 'events' in an Express application, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting events, and fetching event attendees. It integrates middleware for authentication and references an event controller for business logic.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of all events.

methods.name: myEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events created by the authenticated user.

methods.name: details
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific event by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes an event identified by ID.

methods.name: attendees
methods.description: Retrieves the attendee list for a specific event.
